entities.name: Nela Kuburović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nela Kuburović is a Serbian lawyer and politician. She served as the Minister of Justice in the Government of Serbia from 2016 to 2020. Before the appointment, she was Deputy Minister of Justice in the Department of Justice.
